title: Sean McVay gives update on star WR, talks Rams upcoming NFL draft plans

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Sean McVay gives update on star WR, talks Rams upcoming NFL draft plans
sources.description: A familiar face was on hand when the Rams opened the on-field phase of their offseason program on Monday. Puka Nacua, their star wide receiver, is taking part in the program after entering a rehabilitation facility last month.
